source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: The agent is required to query Ask the Oracle to determine whether the delivery delay was a company error prior to making any commitment to the customer.
Before reporting delivery status, the agent must verify identity using full name, account ID, order ID, and phone number via Verify Identity.
